name: Clemson University
header:
Clemson University
United States · Mathematical Sciences PhD
Roster and rank verification handled separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• The current-looking number-theory research page still advises contact with Kevin James. He died in 2023, as
the official memorial conference confirms; do not treat that recommendation as current.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Minimum bachelor’s from approved institution; UChicago degree is an appropriate basis, with school evaluation
of sufficient preparation for doctoral completion. International applicants eligible. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select Mathematical Sciences PhD, prepare 3 referees, statement, resume/CV and academic records; verify
English waiver checklist. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Number-theory page directs prospective students to Hui Xue or Kevin James. Verify current James availability;
page includes at least one obsolete faculty listing. [s6]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Online portal accepts uploads and displays application status; separate customized application needed for
additional program. [s3]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Standing admissions rules; no explicitly 2027 stipend/deadline schedule located. [s1]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application; Funding consideration [Standing rule]
January 15 recommended fall complete-file date; late completed files may still be considered for admission and
financial aid. Standing date, not explicitly labelled 2027. [s1]
Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Submit materials for January 15 target; official English proof/exemption must be cleared before admission
decision. No separate reference grace period published. [s1] [s4]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Central: TOEFL iBT 4.0/Essentials 8.5, IELTS 6.5, DET 115, PTE 54; agency-sent official reports,2-year validity,
ETS 5111. Programs can impose higher standards. [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Earned accredited U.S. degree satisfies requirement. In-progress UChicago degree qualifies for temporary

waiver until first Clemson term; submit official conferral transcript on completion or future registration is held.
Green status-checklist mark confirms English satisfied. [s4]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Recommended, not required; official reports ETS 5111. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics GRE rule located in public school instructions. [s1]

Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Resume/CV uploaded directly; no public limit. [s2]
Statement of purpose; Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
School recommends 1 page on academic interests, career plans and Clemson choice (paraphrased). Central
upload asks career goals and motivation for graduate study in chosen field. [s1] [s2]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]

Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list; Course-list
document; Scholarship essays [Standing rule]

whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s1]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Application asks six community-standards/criminal-disciplinary questions; explanations required for yes
answers, reviewed by separate conduct committee. Exact six questions require portal. [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
Assistantship stipend plus tuition remission; fees still charged (Tier 2 program fees). Health-insurance subsidy
available with university plan. Exact 2027 annual stipend not verified. [s5]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
International eligibility; Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
International assistantships possible; school requires Verification of English Skills Test to retain assistantship.
Admission English exemption should not be assumed to waive teaching certification. [s1]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
All incoming students considered for assistantship support; no separate assistantship application published.
[s5]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
School provides limited research-conference travel funding by request. [s5]
Application fee; Fee waiver [Standing rule]
No graduate application fee; central and school agree. No waiver application needed. [s1] [s3]

sections.text:
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
School transcript wording differs from central unofficial-then-final rule. Research page still lists Keri
Sather-Wagstaff, but current official Framingham leadership lists her there; exclude as confirmed Clemson
supervisor. [s1] [s2] [s6] [s9]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm stipend/duration, commitment date, referee receipt/update/reuse, scholarship extras, Math GRE and
current faculty roster. Recent papers are verified for Coykendall, Burr and the included adjacent algebra
faculty. Kevin James died in 2023 and must not be treated as an adviser despite a stale research-group contact
link. [s1] [s6]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Number theory
Hui Xue
Modular forms, L-functions, periods, elliptic curves. [s7] [s8]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · Twisted periods of modular forms
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Algebraic number theory and commutative algebra
Jim Coykendall
Commutative algebra and algebraic number theory; factorization in integral domains and monoids. [s6] [s10]
[q11]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.

Research evidence: 2026 · On the axioms for a unique factorisation domain
Research-paper evidence. Publication year is as stated; an old paper is not proof of recent activity.
Algebraic geometry (computational)
Michael Burr
Computational algebraic geometry, certified numerical/subdivision algorithms and geometric approximation of
algebraic varieties. [s6] [q12]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2025 · Certified simultaneous isotopic approximation of algebraic curves via subdivision
Research-paper evidence. Publication year is as stated; an old paper is not proof of recent activity.
Number theory / algebraic combinatorics
Neil J. Calkin
Combinatorial and probabilistic number theory; recent algebraic computation investigates eigenvalue spreads
through polynomial resultants. [b14] [b14p]
Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint · On the maximal spread of symmetric Bohemian matrices
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Number theory / computational algebra
Shuhong Gao (directory: Xuhong Gao)
Computational algebra and number theory, finite fields, polynomial systems and cryptography. More applied
than the central arithmetic-geometry interests. [b16] [b16p]
Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint · Security Analysis of Integer Learning with Errors with Rejection Sampling
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Ryann Cartor
Algebraic cryptography, finite-group discrete logarithms and polynomial-system models; an adjacent
applied-algebra option. [b18] [b18p]
Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Quadratic Modelings of Syndrome Decoding
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Felice Manganiello
Coding theory, computational algebra and finite fields, with work linking modular forms to codes; an adjacent
option. [b22] [b22p]
Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2024 · External codes for multiple unicast networks via interference alignment
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Representation theory / algebraic combinatorics
Matthew Macauley
Coxeter groups, geometric and algebraic combinatorics, toric posets and group actions; an adjacent
representation-theoretic option. [b20] [b20p]

Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Fundamental motifs and parity within the crystallographic point groups
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Representation theory / algebraic combinatorics (adjacent)
Svetlana Poznanovikj
Algebraic and enumerative combinatorics, unimodality and log-concavity; broader adjacent work includes
discrete mathematical biology. [b24] [b24p]
Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Unimodality and log-concavity of generalized Glasby-Paseman sequences
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
